lines.2: 「Leo, why don't you clean? You're an eyesore when you stand around daydreaming.」
lines.4: 「He's been like this since lunch for some reason.」
lines.6: She sounded as if she could not have cared less.
lines.7: 「I'll handle the blackboard. You do the floor with Crabby and the others.」
lines.11: Yoshimi must have gotten used to the idiots fooling around, because she kept cleaning steadily by herself.
lines.12: 「If you can't clean properly, you'll never get a room of your own!」
lines.14: A memory from the past came flooding back.
lines.16: Maybe I hadn't forgotten so much as tried to forget.
